description: React component for rendering an agent flow node in a visual flow editor, including UI elements, icons, and node interactions.

methods.name: getStateColor
methods.description: Determines the border color of the node based on selection and hover state.

methods.name: getOutputAnchors
methods.description: Returns the output anchors for the node.

methods.name: getAnchorPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of output handle anchors based on node height.

methods.name: getMinimumHeight
methods.description: Calculates the minimum height of the node based on output anchors.

methods.name: getBackgroundColor
methods.description: Determines the background color based on theme mode and hover state.

methods.name: getStatusBackgroundColor
methods.description: Returns background color based on node status.

methods.name: renderIcon
methods.description: Renders the icon associated with a node based on its name.

methods.name: getBuiltInOpenAIToolIcon
methods.description: Returns icon component for built-in OpenAI tools.

methods.name: getBuiltInGeminiToolIcon
methods.description: Returns icon component for built-in Gemini tools.

methods.name: getBuiltInAnthropicToolIcon
methods.description: Returns icon component for built-in Anthropic tools.
